# Clean-room extension registry snapshots

Platform: native macOS 8.3.27.2214. See the OpenSpec native evidence for the
commands, physical registry profile and binary hashes.

The base uses `_onecdec/fixture_src/cfe_base`, with a synthetic common module
added. The first extension starts with `_onecdec/fixture_src/ТестРасширение`
and adopts that base module. The second has independent configuration,
module and language identities while its language's adopted-object reference
still points at the base language. There are no users or business records.

- `staged.1CD.gz`: both extensions have just been loaded, before apply.
- `applied.1CD.gz`: each extension was explicitly applied with Designer
  `/UpdateDBCfg -Extension <name>`.
- `mixed.1CD.gz`: the first applied extension's own module has a new comment
  loaded but not applied; the second remains active.

Gzip uses mtime zero. `native-hashes.json` records native ibcmd output hashes
for every path; expectations are never generated by the candidate exporter.
The initial second-extension source had an incorrect adopted-language id;
it was accepted for export but correctly refused on apply, then fixed before
the applied and mixed snapshots. That initial snapshot tests reading a
prepared image, not runtime applicability. Full native XML trees are not
included; the snapshots are small clean-room file-format fixtures only.
